title: Fatigue and Work
text: Work-related fatigue can be connected to night work, extended hours, demanding tasks, stress, and heat. Fatigue can reduce attention, reaction time, short-term memory, and judgment. Prevention should address the sources of fatigue.

title: Firefighter Safety and Health
text: Firefighter hazards include heat stress and risks associated with shift work and disrupted sleep. These hazards support team-level monitoring but do not establish that an individual is impaired.

title: Workplace Recommendations for Heat Stress
topic: heat hydration cooling work rest cycle weather
text: Heat controls can include hydration, acclimatization, monitoring, administrative controls, and adjusted work-rest periods. Protective equipment and physical exertion add to heat load.

title: API Web Service
topic: weather alert warning advisory current expiration
text: The National Weather Service API provides official alert data with location and timing information. Decision support should preserve issued and expiration times and should reject products that are not current.

title: Emergency Responder Health, Safety and Wellness
topic: firefighter fatigue heat sleep recovery readiness
text: Responder health and safety resources address sleep deprivation, rehabilitation, heat, fatigue, and volunteer firefighter well-being through risk-management approaches.

title: Warfighter Performance Optimization–Total Force Fitness
topic: guard reserve readiness recovery duty performance
text: Total Force Fitness describes connected health, performance, and readiness factors for the total force.

title: Fire and Emergency Services
topic: staffing coverage fire rescue dispatch readiness
text: The Cranberry Township Volunteer Fire Company provides fire and rescue services. The township lists Haine and Park stations and a Public Safety Training Facility. Butler County 911 dispatches the company.
